headline: PM Tarique Rahman inaugurates July Uprising Museum to preserve memories
summary: The museum is dedicated to preserving the memories of the July 2024 mass uprising that led to political change in Bangladesh.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated the July Mass Uprising Memorial Museum, a facility dedicated to preserving the records and memories of the 2024 uprising.
The museum aims to serve as a permanent record of the events that took place during the July movement, ensuring that the future generations understand the struggle.
During the inauguration, the Prime Minister emphasized the importance of preserving history to learn from the past and build a better future for the country.
The facility will house artifacts, documents, and stories from the July uprising, providing a comprehensive look at the the movement's impact on the nation.
caption:
A new museum opens to honor the July 2024 mass uprising. Prime Minister Tarique Rahman officially inaugurated the facility.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated the July Mass Uprising Memorial Museum, a facility dedicated to preserving the records and memories of the 2024 uprising.

The museum aims to serve as a permanent record of the events that took place during the July movement, ensuring that the future generations understand the struggle.

During the inauguration, the Prime Minister emphasized the importance of preserving history to learn from the past and build a better future for the country.

The facility will house artifacts, documents, and stories from the July uprising, providing a comprehensive look at the the movement's impact on the nation.

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, Somoy News

headline: PM warns against attempts to create instability to aid fallen autocracy
summary: Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus warns that some are creating unnecessary issues to destabilize the country following the fall of the previous regime.
details: Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus has warned against attempts to create instability in Bangladesh, stating that some individuals are intentionally creating unnecessary issues to destabilize the country.
The Prime Minister noted that these efforts are aimed at aiding the return of the fallen autocracy, suggesting that elements from the previous regime are still active.
He emphasized that the nation is currently in a transition period and that maintaining stability is crucial for the rebuilding process.
Yunus called on the citizens to remain vigilant and avoid being misled by those who wish to see the country slide back into authoritarianism.
The Prime Minister stressed that the government is committed to fulfilling the aspirations of the people and rebuilding the country on a foundation of justice and democracy.
caption:
Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus warns that some are intentionally creating instability to bring back the fallen autocracy.

Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus has warned against attempts to create instability in Bangladesh, stating that some individuals are intentionally creating unnecessary issues to destabilize the country.

The Prime Minister noted that these efforts are aimed at aiding the return of the fallen autocracy, suggesting that elements from the previous regime are still active.

He emphasized that the nation is currently in a transition period and that maintaining stability is crucial for the rebuilding process.

Yunus called on the citizens to remain vigilant and avoid being misled by those who wish to see the country slide back into authoritarianism.

The Prime Minister stressed that the government is committed to fulfilling the aspirations of the people and rebuilding the country on a foundation of justice and democracy.
